sandbox_equivalence: No model-generated or user-supplied Python is executed. A fixed-operation interpreter receives only validated, workspace-scoped extracted previews capped at 100 rows and emits capped validated JSON plus authenticated artifacts. This removes the executable surface that would otherwise require a Docker code sandbox.
license_impact: PandasAI is not imported. No ee or enterprise-licensed path is used; pandas remains the pre-existing published dependency.
rollback: Revert the D merge commit; document and image analysis remain on the previous grounded routes.
